subject.title: feat(agents): add scoped command prompt projection

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this command inventory as a public plugin API and model-prompt surface, and may host CLI guidance appear by default when `exec` is available?
rationale: The patch creates permanent external plugin descriptor fields and changes default model instructions; code correctness cannot determine whether those product and compatibility contracts should exist.

options.title: Narrow specialized projection
options.body: Require explicit caller-scoped inventories, keep ordinary prompts unchanged, and review the plugin metadata contract separately in the foundation PR.

options.title: Accept the broader contract
options.body: Approve default host command guidance and the public plugin metadata API with documented upgrade and trust-boundary expectations.

options.title: Hold the stacked draft
options.body: Pause this PR until the command inventory and live-node prerequisites establish stable contracts worth consuming.

recommendation.title: Narrow specialized projection
recommendation.body: Require explicit caller-scoped inventories, keep ordinary prompts unchanged, and review the plugin metadata contract separately in the foundation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history most strongly connects this person to all three decision surfaces: system prompts, plugin contracts, and node command policy.
